title: I spent 3 days building Procedural Pixel Asset Generator for 2D Retro Pixel Games
author: CuriousDivide5546
selftext:
Every game needs sprites — characters, creatures, weapons, environments.

Went looking for free assets online. They all look mismatched. Different styles, different scales, different vibes. Unusable. 

Kenny assets were good - but very limited.

Asset packs cost money. I'm at MVP stage for my Product. Not spending $200 on art when I don't even have users yet.

Hiring a pixel artist is overkill when you're still figuring out if the thing even works.

So I did what any slightly unhinged solo builder does.

I spent 3 days building my own asset generator instead.

One input → full cohesive art pack. Characters, creatures, weapons, environments. 18 categories, 8 variations each. Forest theme, City theme, Space theme, Cave theme. Roll a new seed and the entire pack regenerates with a consistent visual style.

No files. No downloads. No artist. Generated entirely in code.

Was this on my roadmap? No.

Did it unblock every single thing that came after it? Completely.
